activity.notes: Kirsan Ilyumzhinov became the first elected President of the Republic of Kalmykia in April 1993. The office title changed from President to Head of the Republic in October 2005, so ATLAS separates the two formal-title phases.

sources.title: Kirsan Ilyumzhinov — Biography
sources.citation_text: Ilyumzhinov's biography records him as President of the Republic of Kalmykia from April 1993 to October 2010.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Energy — Fact Sheet: President Ilumzhinov and Republic of Kalmykia
sources.citation_text: The contemporary 1993 fact sheet identifies Ilyumzhinov as the elected President of the Republic of Kalmykia.
